papers.title: On Active Learning for Gaussian Process-based Global Sensitivity Analysis
papers.abstract: This paper explores the application of active learning strategies to adaptively learn Sobol indices for global sensitivity analysis. We demonstrate that active learning for Sobol indices poses unique challenges due to the definition of the Sobol index as a ratio of variances estimated from Gaussian process surrogates. Consequently, learning strategies must either focus on convergence in the numerator or the denominator of this ratio. However, rapid convergence in either one does not guarantee convergence in the Sobol index. We propose a novel strategy for active learning that focuses on resolving the main effects of the Gaussian process (associated with the numerator of the Sobol index) and compare this with existing strategies based on convergence in the total variance (the denominator of the Sobol index). The new strategy, implemented through a new learning function termed the MUSIC (minimize uncertainty in Sobol index convergence), generally converges in Sobol index error more rapidly than the existing strategies based on the Expected Improvement for Global Fit (EIGF) and the Variance Improvement for Global Fit (VIGF). Both strategies are compared with simple sequential random sampling and the MUSIC learning function generally converges most rapidly for low-dimensional problems. However, for high-dimensional problems, the performance is comparable to random sampling. The new learning strategy is demonstrated for a practical case of adaptive experimental design for large-scale Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel experiments.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出主动学习策略加速高斯过程灵敏度分析，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的不确定性量化。

summary_zh.motivation: 自适应学习Sobol指标面临方差比收敛难题，需新策略。
summary_zh.method: 提出MUSIC学习函数，聚焦主效应不确定性最小化。
summary_zh.result: 低维问题收敛快于EIGF和VIGF，高维与随机采样相当。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准和风洞实验验证收敛性能。

summary_en.motivation: Active learning for Sobol indices is challenging due to the ratio-of-variances definition, requiring strategies that ensure index convergence rather than just numerator or denominator.
summary_en.method: A new learning function, MUSIC, is proposed that minimizes uncertainty in Sobol index convergence by focusing on the main effects of the Gaussian process.
summary_en.result: MUSIC achieves faster convergence in Sobol index error than EIGF and VIGF for low-dimensional problems, but performs similarly to random sampling in high dimensions.
summary_en.validation: Validation includes numerical benchmarks and a practical wind tunnel experiment demonstrating adaptive experimental design.

papers.title: Selective Laser Melting of Al-Cu-Mn-Mg Alloys: Processing and Mechanical Properties
papers.abstract: Al-Cu-Mn-Mg alloys containing Zr were produced via selective laser melting (SLM). The processing parameters were analyzed via an orthogonal experiment, and the microstructure and mechanical properties of the specimens were investigated. The results showed that the laser power and scanning speed were the main factors affecting the density and hardness of the specimens. The optimal parameters for the SLM processing of Al-Cu-Mn-Mg alloy were a laser power of 300 W, scanning speed of 1100 mm/s, and hatch spacing of 0.12 mm. The microstructure of the specimen was made of fine equiaxed grains and columnar grains, and Al2Cu precipitates were found in the as-printed alloy. The alloy was isotropic, and the hardness was around 100 HV. The tensile and yield strength of the alloy were 361 MPa and 266 MPa, and the elongation was 5.4%. The superior mechanical properties can be attributed to the synergy effect of the strengthening of the grain boundary, solid solution, and precipitation.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究铝合金SLM工艺，与生物医学方向无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化Al-Cu-Mn-Mg合金SLM工艺参数并研究其力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 通过正交实验分析激光功率、扫描速度等参数对密度和硬度的影响。
summary_zh.result: 最优参数下合金抗拉强度361 MPa，延伸率5.4%，组织为细等轴晶和柱状晶。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、硬度测试和微观组织表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize selective laser melting parameters for Al-Cu-Mn-Mg alloys and characterize their mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: Orthogonal experiments were conducted to analyze the effects of laser power, scanning speed, and hatch spacing on density and hardness.
summary_en.result: Optimal parameters yielded a tensile strength of 361 MPa, yield strength of 266 MPa, and elongation of 5.4%, with a microstructure of fine equiaxed and columnar grains.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through tensile testing, hardness measurements, and microstructural analysis.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文为临床结局研究，未涉及任何生物力学或植入物力学分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical outcomes study with no biomechanical modeling, FEA, stress shielding, micromotion, or implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估90岁以上患者初次与翻修全髋置换的住院结局。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析国家住院数据库。
summary_zh.result: 非老年患者并发症率可接受，但翻修风险高。

summary_en.motivation: To assess short-term outcomes after primary and revision total hip arthroplasty in patients aged 90 years and older.
summary_en.method: A retrospective analysis of the National Inpatient Sample database was performed.
summary_en.result: Nonagenarian patients had acceptable complication rates but higher mortality and resource utilization.
summary_en.validation: Statistical comparison of clinical outcomes with younger cohorts.
